string-array.name: whatsnew_notes
string-array.item: New: calls now run on Tawny\'s own native engine instead of a web page inside the app. Every screen stays where it was, and your pairings come across
New: pinch to zoom where your fingers are, and move the picture to see any part of the room
Fixed: a call repairs itself when its network path drops, and finds a Monitor that restarted
Fixed: a phone Monitor held upright shows the right way up on every Viewer, an iPhone included
